In this repository (working dir /bench/repo), markdown processing sits behind an interface (an abstraction — could be a TypeScript interface, an abstract class, a Go interface, a trait, etc.). I need you to find:

1. The interface/abstraction that defines markdown processing (name it, cite file path + line).
2. Which concrete implementation(s) of that interface actually execute at runtime (name each, cite file paths). If there are multiple implementations, note which are real/production vs test/mock/no-op.
3. Who constructs these implementations (where are they instantiated / injected — dependency injection, factory, constructor calls). Cite file paths + lines.
4. Which components (classes/services/modules) hold a reference to the interface (i.e. depend on the abstraction). Cite file paths.

Search thoroughly. Look for terms like "markdown", "Markdown", "MarkdownProcessor", "IMarkdown", "renderMarkdown", "markdownToHtml", "remark", "marked", "markdown-it", etc. Report concrete file paths and line numbers for everything. Be precise about distinguishing the interface from implementations.

1	package renderer
2	
3	import (
4		"bytes"
5		"fmt"
6		"strings"
7	
8		gast "github.com/yuin/goldmark/ast"
9		east "github.com/yuin/goldmark/extension/ast"
10	
11		mast "github.com/usememos/memos/internal/markdown/ast"
12	)
13	
14	// MarkdownRenderer renders goldmark AST back to markdown text.
15	type MarkdownRenderer struct {
16		buf *bytes.Buffer
17	}
18	
19	// NewMarkdownRenderer creates a new markdown renderer.
20	func NewMarkdownRenderer() *MarkdownRenderer {
21		return &MarkdownRenderer{
22			buf: &bytes.Buffer{},
23		}
24	}
25	
26	// Render renders the AST node to markdown and returns the result.
27	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) Render(node gast.Node, source []byte) string {
28		r.buf.Reset()
29		r.renderNode(node, source, 0)
30		return r.buf.String()
31	}
32	
33	// renderNode renders a single node and its children.
34	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderNode(node gast.Node, source []byte, depth int) {
35		switch n := node.(type) {
36		case *gast.Document:
37			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
38	
39		case *gast.Paragraph:
40			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
41			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
42				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
43			}
44	
45		case *gast.Text:
46			// Text nodes store their content as segments in the source
47			segment := n.Segment
48			r.buf.Write(segment.Value(source))
49			if n.SoftLineBreak() {
50				r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
51			} else if n.HardLineBreak() {
52				r.buf.WriteString("  \n")
53			}
54	
55		case *gast.CodeSpan:
56			r.buf.WriteByte('`')
57			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
58			r.buf.WriteByte('`')
59	
60		case *gast.Emphasis:
61			symbol := "*"
62			if n.Level == 2 {
63				symbol = "**"
64			}
65			r.buf.WriteString(symbol)
66			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
67			r.buf.WriteString(symbol)
68	
69		case *gast.Link:
70			r.buf.WriteString("[")
71			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
72			r.buf.WriteString("](")
73			r.buf.Write(n.Destination)
74			if len(n.Title) > 0 {
75				r.buf.WriteString(` "`)
76				r.buf.Write(n.Title)
77				r.buf.WriteString(`"`)
78			}
79			r.buf.WriteString(")")
80	
81		case *gast.AutoLink:
82			url := n.URL(source)
83			if n.AutoLinkType == gast.AutoLinkEmail {
84				r.buf.WriteString("<")
85				r.buf.Write(url)
86				r.buf.WriteString(">")
87			} else {
88				r.buf.Write(url)
89			}
90	
91		case *gast.Image:
92			r.buf.WriteString("![")
93			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
94			r.buf.WriteString("](")
95			r.buf.Write(n.Destination)
96			if len(n.Title) > 0 {
97				r.buf.WriteString(` "`)
98				r.buf.Write(n.Title)
99				r.buf.WriteString(`"`)
100			}
101			r.buf.WriteString(")")
102	
103		case *gast.Heading:
104			r.buf.WriteString(strings.Repeat("#", n.Level))
105			r.buf.WriteByte(' ')
106			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
107			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
108				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
109			}
110	
111		case *gast.CodeBlock, *gast.FencedCodeBlock:
112			r.renderCodeBlock(n, source)
113	
114		case *gast.Blockquote:
115			// Render each child line with "> " prefix
116			r.renderBlockquote(n, source, depth)
117			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
118				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
119			}
120	
121		case *gast.List:
122			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
123			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
124				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
125			}
126	
127		case *gast.ListItem:
128			r.renderListItem(n, source, depth)
129	
130		case *gast.ThematicBreak:
131			r.buf.WriteString("---")
132			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
133				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
134			}
135	
136		case *east.Strikethrough:
137			r.buf.WriteString("~~")
138			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
139			r.buf.WriteString("~~")
140	
141		case *east.TaskCheckBox:
142			if n.IsChecked {
143				r.buf.WriteString("[x] ")
144			} else {
145				r.buf.WriteString("[ ] ")
146			}
147	
148		case *east.Table:
149			r.renderTable(n, source)
150			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
151				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
152			}
153	
154		// Custom Memos nodes
155		case *mast.TagNode:
156			r.buf.WriteByte('#')
157			r.buf.Write(n.Tag)
158	
159		case *mast.MentionNode:
160			r.buf.WriteByte('@')
161			r.buf.Write(n.Username)
162	
163		default:
164			// For unknown nodes, try to render children
165			r.renderChildren(n, source, depth)
166		}
167	}
168	
169	// renderChildren renders all children of a node.
170	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderChildren(node gast.Node, source []byte, depth int) {
171		child := node.FirstChild()
172		for child != nil {
173			r.renderNode(child, source, depth+1)
174			child = child.NextSibling()
175		}
176	}
177	
178	// renderCodeBlock renders a code block.
179	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderCodeBlock(node gast.Node, source []byte) {
180		if fenced, ok := node.(*gast.FencedCodeBlock); ok {
181			// Fenced code block with language
182			r.buf.WriteString("```")
183			if lang := fenced.Language(source); len(lang) > 0 {
184				r.buf.Write(lang)
185			}
186			r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
187	
188			// Write all lines
189			lines := fenced.Lines()
190			for i := 0; i < lines.Len(); i++ {
191				line := lines.At(i)
192				r.buf.Write(line.Value(source))
193			}
194	
195			r.buf.WriteString("```")
196			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
197				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
198			}
199		} else if codeBlock, ok := node.(*gast.CodeBlock); ok {
200			// Indented code block
201			lines := codeBlock.Lines()
202			for i := 0; i < lines.Len(); i++ {
203				line := lines.At(i)
204				r.buf.WriteString("    ")
205				r.buf.Write(line.Value(source))
206			}
207			if node.NextSibling() != nil {
208				r.buf.WriteString("\n\n")
209			}
210		}
211	}
212	
213	// renderBlockquote renders a blockquote with "> " prefix.
214	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderBlockquote(node *gast.Blockquote, source []byte, depth int) {
215		// Create a temporary buffer for the blockquote content
216		tempBuf := &bytes.Buffer{}
217		tempRenderer := &MarkdownRenderer{buf: tempBuf}
218		tempRenderer.renderChildren(node, source, depth)
219	
220		// Add "> " prefix to each line
221		content := tempBuf.String()
222		lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimRight(content, "\n"), "\n")
223		for i, line := range lines {
224			r.buf.WriteString("> ")
225			r.buf.WriteString(line)
226			if i < len(lines)-1 {
227				r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
228			}
229		}
230	}
231	
232	// renderListItem renders a list item with proper indentation and markers.
233	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderListItem(node *gast.ListItem, source []byte, depth int) {
234		parent := node.Parent()
235		list, ok := parent.(*gast.List)
236		if !ok {
237			r.renderChildren(node, source, depth)
238			return
239		}
240	
241		// Add indentation only for nested lists
242		// Document=0, List=1, ListItem=2 (no indent), nested ListItem=3+ (indent)
243		if depth > 2 {
244			indent := strings.Repeat("  ", depth-2)
245			r.buf.WriteString(indent)
246		}
247	
248		// Add list marker
249		if list.IsOrdered() {
250			fmt.Fprintf(r.buf, "%d. ", list.Start)
251			list.Start++ // Increment for next item
252		} else {
253			r.buf.WriteString("- ")
254		}
255	
256		// Render content
257		r.renderChildren(node, source, depth)
258	
259		// Add newline if there's a next sibling
260		if node.NextSibling() != nil {
261			r.buf.WriteByte('\n')
262		}
263	}
264	
265	// renderTable renders a table in markdown format.
266	func (r *MarkdownRenderer) renderTable(table *east.Table, source []byte) {
267		// This is a simplified table renderer
268		// A full implementation would need to handle alignment, etc.
269		r.renderChildren(table, source, 0)
270	}

I have a complete picture. Here's my report.

## Markdown Processing Architecture in `/bench/repo` (Memos)

There are two markdown subsystems: a **Go backend** (which uses a real interface abstraction) and a **React frontend** (which does *not* use an interface — it wires `react-markdown` directly). The interface/abstraction the task asks about is the Go one.

### 1. The interface/abstraction

**`markdown.Service`** — a Go interface at `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:31` (declaration spans lines 31–55).

It defines the markdown-processing contract: `ExtractAll`, `ExtractTags`, `ExtractProperties`, `RenderMarkdown`, `RenderHTML`, `GenerateSnippet`, `ValidateContent`, `RenameTag`. Its doc comment (lines 27–30) explicitly notes HTML rendering is primarily done on the frontend with markdown-it, while the backend provides `RenderHTML` for RSS/server-side needs.

### 2. Concrete implementation(s) that execute at runtime

Only **one** concrete implementation exists — there are no mocks, fakes, or no-ops:

- **`service` struct** — `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:57-60` (unexported), wrapping a `goldmark.Markdown` engine (`github.com/yuin/goldmark`). All eight interface methods are implemented on `*service` (lines 143–453). This is the real/production implementation, and tests use it directly (no test double).

A helper renderer, `renderer.MarkdownRenderer` (`/bench/repo/internal/markdown/renderer/markdown_renderer.go:15`), is used internally by `service.RenderMarkdown`/`RenameTag` (constructed at markdown.go:250 and 451) — but it is a plain struct, not an implementation of `markdown.Service`.

Frontend note: `/bench/repo/web/src/components/MemoContent/MemoMarkdownRenderer.tsx` renders markdown via `ReactMarkdown` (remark/rehype plugins). It is a concrete React component with **no interface abstraction** behind it.

### 3. Who constructs the implementation

The factory is **`markdown.NewService(opts ...Option) Service`** at `/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:85` (returns `&service{...}`, line 110). Uses a functional-options pattern (`WithTagExtension`, `WithMentionExtension`).

Production construction / injection site:
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48-51` — `NewAPIV1Service(...)` calls `markdown.NewService(WithTagExtension(), WithMentionExtension())` and stores it in `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (v1.go:56). **This is the single production instance.**
- It is then hand-injected into the RSS service at `/bench/repo/server/server.go:85`: `rss.NewRSSService(s.Profile, s.Store, apiV1Service.MarkdownService)`.

Other construction sites (tests only):
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/test/test_helper.go:44-52`
- `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss_test.go:54`
- `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver_test.go:427`

### 4. Components holding a reference to the `markdown.Service` interface (depend on the abstraction)

- **`APIV1Service`** — field `MarkdownService markdown.Service` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`. Consumed in:
  - `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` and `:447` (via `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload`)
  - `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:32` (`ExtractAll`)
  - `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:85` (`GenerateSnippet`)
- **`RSSService`** — field `MarkdownService markdown.Service` at `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:45`; used at `/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:339` (`RenderHTML`).
- **`memopayload` package** — the free function `RebuildMemoPayload(_, memo, markdownService markdown.Service)` at `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74` takes the interface as a parameter (this is the actual production call path). The package also defines a `Runner` struct with a `MarkdownService markdown.Service` field (`runner.go:16`, constructed by `NewRunner`, `runner.go:19`) — but `NewRunner`/`Runner.RunOnce` are **not called anywhere in production or tests**, so that struct is effectively dead code; only the standalone `RebuildMemoPayload` function is live.

### Summary
- Interface: `markdown.Service` (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:31`).
- Single real implementation: unexported `service` struct (same file, line 57), goldmark-backed; no mocks/no-ops.
- Factory: `markdown.NewService` (line 85); one production instance built in `NewAPIV1Service` (`v1.go:48`).
- Dependents: `APIV1Service`, `RSSService`, and `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` (plus the unused `memopayload.Runner`).
- The frontend markdown renderer is separate and has no interface abstraction.
